nom: ANUA KPop Demon Hunters 8 Hyaluronic Acid Catechin Cool Slim Mask

avis.texte: This may be my favorite face mask I've ever tried. It smelled good, but it also felt *amazing* on my skin. I'm a big fan of the cooling sensation, and the one deom the mask lasted up to 30 minutes even after I had taken the sheet off my face. Will definitely purchase again!
